description: This file implements cache manipulation routines, specifically cache flushing, for a Linux-based embedded system loader using LZMA compression on Atheros AR7XXX/AR9XXX boards. It contains functions to perform cache line invalidation and writeback, utilizing inline assembly for cache operations.

methods.name: void flush_cache(unsigned long start_addr,unsigned long size)
methods.description: Flushes a cache range by invalidating and writing back cache lines within a specified memory region.

ctags.name: flush_cache
ctags.pattern: /^void flush_cache(unsigned long start_addr, unsigned long size)$/
